purpose: Screenshot-based marketing artwork for the Omarchy preview

assets.name: 01-omarchy-launch
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / screenshot compositing.
Create a beautiful, finished product launch graphic for OpenWhisper's custom Omarchy interface. Landscape 16:9, high resolution, suitable for an X image attachment.
INPUTS: image 1 is the REAL app screenshot, the immutable product insert. Image 2 is the existing OpenWhisper microphone app icon, use as the brand mark. Preserve their contents, spelling, colors and layout; do not redesign the app. Only uniformly scale/crop the screenshot and place it in the composition. The app screenshot MUST be the primary visual, crisp and big enough to recognize. No invented UI elements.
ART DIRECTION: premium independent Linux software editorial campaign, restrained Tokyo Night palette: near-black navy #151620, periwinkle #7aa2f7, ice lavender #c0caf5, tiny lime #9ece6a. Tactile fine paper grain, beautifully precise grid, large modern grotesk typography with small monospaced technical labels. A subtle architectural sound-wave contour behind the product, not a glowing AI blob. Shallow polished shadow beneath the flat app panel, thin periwinkle frame, squared corners. Cool and confident, carefully art-directed, generous breathing room. No laptop or phone mockup.
COMPOSITION: brand small top-left with icon; a striking two-line title in the upper third; the actual app screenshot as a large flat panel below occupying about 65% of canvas width, balanced with a slim editorial left rail. Keep all important app controls and footer visible; cropping empty internal space is acceptable only if preserving all UI relationships. Do not add a titlebar or traffic-light buttons. Subtle grid/corner registration marks, no clutter.
TEXT outside screenshot exactly:
"OpenWhisper"
"Your voice."
"At home on Omarchy."
"HYPRLAND · WAYLAND · QUICKSHELL"
"OMARCHY PREVIEW"
No additional marketing text, URL, price, endorsement, stars, awards or false release claims. The preview label should be small but readable. The whole composition should feel like a premium software launch poster, not a screenshot pasted on a generic gradient.

assets.name: 02-made-for-tiling
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / screenshot compositing.
Create a finished square 1:1 product feature poster for OpenWhisper's custom Omarchy UI.
INPUTS: image 1 is the actual Settings overview in a wide window. Image 2 is the same actual UI reflowed in a narrow window. These are immutable screenshots: preserve their exact UI, text, colors, rectangular controls and content. Crop or uniformly scale to fit; never invent, simplify or redraw the interface. Image 3 is the existing app icon.
ART DIRECTION: premium independent Linux software campaign; Tokyo Night near-black navy #151620, ice lavender #c0caf5 and sharp periwinkle #7aa2f7; restrained lime highlight. Swiss editorial typography, precise modular grid, fine physical paper grain, subtle engineered linework suggesting tiled window arrangements. Beautiful large whitespace and disciplined optical alignment. Flat front-facing panels, exceptionally crisp screenshots, squared corners, soft minimal shadows; no dramatic perspective.
COMPOSITION: small OpenWhisper wordmark/icon and discreet preview label at top. Large two-line headline. A carefully composed pair of REAL screenshot panels below, wide settings view larger behind and narrow view in front, showing the authentic responsive card stacking; the front panel may cover the lower right of the back panel but must keep the overview and sidebar readable. These two panels are the primary visual. A clean three-item feature strip at the bottom with simple precise geometric markers, outside the screenshots.
TEXT outside screenshot exactly:
"OpenWhisper"
"Made for your"
"tiling life."
"Hyprland sizing"
"Live theme colors"
"Desktop shortcuts"
"OMARCHY PREVIEW"
Do not add window buttons, a macOS frame, a fake desktop, or fabricated settings. No empty generic device mockup, no stock photo, no neon blob, no claims of official endorsement. This should be a stunning cohesive launch asset with an authentic practical product story.

assets.name: 03-full-toolkit
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / screenshot compositing.
Create a beautiful finished square 1:1 campaign graphic for OpenWhisper's new custom Omarchy interface, emphasizing retained workflows.
INPUTS: image 1 is the REAL Quick Record screenshot. Image 2 is the REAL Upload File screenshot. Preserve the screens exactly: existing words, navigation, record controls and drop zone, colors, layout. These are product inserts, not inspiration to create a new UI. Uniform scaling and outer cropping are allowed. Image 3 is the OpenWhisper microphone logo.
ART DIRECTION: same cohesive premium Linux product campaign: ink navy #151620, lavender #c0caf5, periwinkle #7aa2f7, small lime accent, subtle paper texture, disciplined grid. Large high-design grotesk headline with elegant line breaks, small monospaced labels. Thin crisp borders and square geometry consistent with Omarchy. An understated waveform composed of fine horizontal lines in the background connects the two windows. No glowing blob or fake 3D hardware.
COMPOSITION: small logo and wordmark top-left, preview badge top-right. Huge headline in top quarter, with lime used only on the word "Full". Beneath it a clear dual-window product composition: Quick Record on left and Upload File on right, lightly overlapping only at the outer edges so the actual controls remain visible. Crop excess empty bottom interior if necessary, without changing the UI content. Use full front-facing rectangular screenshots, not perspective distortions. At bottom a carefully aligned 2-row, 3-column typographic feature index, understated dividers and ample spacing; this is poster copy outside the screenshots, never a fake app menu.
TEXT outside screenshot exactly:
"OpenWhisper"
"New look."
"Full toolkit."
"Dictation" "Uploads" "Meetings"
"Profiles" "History" "Host mode"
"OMARCHY PREVIEW"
No other external text. No performance statistics, claims that all engines support Linux, download-now CTA, official partnership claim, redesigned app controls or added window chrome. Make it memorable, clear, and polished enough to share as a software product launch.
